correctness.rationale: The n×n S5 frame has reflexive named row and column equivalences, with atom p(i,j) iff j=i or j=i−1 and n≥3. At zero depth p has two types. Ordinary bisimulation never splits them because every row and column meets both colors. For graded depth t, a cell signature is exactly (p,previous row-type histogram,previous column-type histogram). The marked-edge graph is the alternating Hamilton path r0–c0–r1–…–r(n−1)–c(n−1), whose degree/histogram recursion peels one row and one column alternately. At depth 1≤t≤n−2, there are (t+1)² Cartesian histogram blocks and precisely three mixed-color blocks; hence K_t=(t+1)²+3, with K_{n−1}=n², and n−1 is minimal. Any nonconstant one-bit valuation has ≥2 ordinary classes, bounding G/B≤n²/2; the construction attains it. Independently written exact count-histogram refinement over every 3≤n≤17 reproduced the full spectrum, including n=5: 2,7,12,19,25; not used as infinite proof. The induction, not the finite experiment, supports the unrestricted quantifiers.
